sloka: अदृष्ट्वा तत्र वैदेहीम् संनिरीक्ष्य च सर्वशः ।उवाच रामः प्राक्रुश्य प्रगृह्य रुचिरौ भुजौ ॥३-६१-२॥
transliteration: adṛṣṭvā tatra vaidehīm saṁnirīkṣya ca sarvaśaḥ ।uvāca rāmaḥ prākruśya pragṛhya rucirau bhujau ॥3-61-2॥

translations.english: Rama, son of Dasaratha, saw the empty cottage devoid of Sita. The mats were displaced. He searched everywhere but unable to see Vaidehi lifted his lovely arms and said:
